name: beehaviors
headline: Everything alive is a *bee*
say: Every behavior in Hypercomb is a bee, short for beehavior: a small, self-contained part that knows when it is needed, and acts. Navigation, editing, games, the words you type: all of them are bees. Each one is named by its signature, so anyone can read it, improve it, and share it back. And nothing runs on faith. Before you take a bee from someone else, you can try it on their domain, and have your own A.I. read it for you. Powers stay off until you allow them.
